subject.title: fix(anthropic): restrict OAuth callback host to loopback addresses and derive redirect URI

question: Should Anthropic OAuth reject all non-loopback OPENCLAW_OAUTH_CALLBACK_HOST values while keeping the provider-visible redirect URI fixed at http://localhost:53692/callback?
rationale: This changes an auth-provider environment surface from permissive to fail-closed and relies on a provider redirect contract that mocked tests and source inspection cannot fully validate for existing users.

options.title: Accept After Proof
options.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and an allowed loopback callback path, then accept the fixed-localhost redirect contract.

options.title: Require Stronger Provider Evidence
options.body: Ask for live Anthropic or installed-client evidence that localhost is the required redirect URI for the supported loopback binds before merge.

options.title: Pause For Auth Redesign
options.body: Pause this PR if the desired direction is to remove or redesign the Anthropic callback-host override instead of hardening it narrowly.

recommendation.title: Accept After Proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted current-head CLI/login proof for invalid-host rejection and an allowed loopback callback path, then accept the fixed-localhost redirect contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned and authored the latest behavior-shaping commits, making him the best current owner for the auth compatibility decision.
